description: Zero-abstraction Postgres for TypeScript: types cast from your database schema. A maintained fork of Zapatos.
rules: pgcast is installed under the zapatos alias (npm install zapatos@npm:pgcast): import * as db from 'zapatos/db' and import type * as s from 'zapatos/schema', never from 'pgcast'.
The types come from the database: run npx pgcast after a migration, and never edit zapatos/schema.d.ts by hand.
Pass the pool or client to .run(pool) every time: there is no global client.
Never concatenate a value into SQL or pass one to db.raw(): a value goes in a shortcut's object, a Whereable or db.param(), and Postgres gets it as a parameter.
Prefer the shortcuts (select, selectOne, count, insert, upsert, update, deletes, lateral) and drop down to a db.sql template only for what they don't cover.
